dedupe_keys.name: geotel cell tower location data us towers cell sites antennas and sectors

description: GeoTel's cell tower location data is a commercial point dataset of cell towers and cell sites, with antenna, ownership, height or elevation hints and general sector direction where reported, marketed for mapping towers by city, region or market across the United States. Planners can check the closest cellular asset to a site, compare operators and coverage patterns, screen for poor coverage and assess line of sight and frequency bands, including C band and LTE context. Producer: GeoTel, which also runs the TeleTracker browser application; the page does not state the number of towers or the update date. Coverage: the United States, judging by the market references on the page. Access: delivered in standard GIS formats or opened in TeleTracker; the only route on the page is a request for a demo, so prices and licence terms are on request. Licence and cost: commercial, not stated. Caveats: attributes are described as typical, not guaranteed, the data are not free to download and coverage is not independently validated here. Simulation uses: tower and antenna positions can seed coverage, capacity-planning and network-flow models of mobile networks. Related records: OpenCelliD (data-opencellid) and the CellMapper crowdsourced tower map (data-cellmapper-crowdsourced-cell-tower-map).
